es: Condensar frases con elipsis, sustitución con one, cláusulas relativas reducidas y nominalización sin perder claridad, y saber qué omitir al resumir.

teaching.en: Tom will attend the planning meeting if he can, and Sara will too, but neither of them has confirmed a time yet.
teaching.es: Tom asistirá a la reunión de planificación si puede, y Sara también, pero ninguno de los dos ha confirmado todavía una hora.
teaching.explanationEs: Tras will se omite «attend the planning meeting»: el lector ya lo sabe. Repite solo el auxiliar.
segments: Tom will attend the planning meeting if he can, and Sara
will too, but neither of them has confirmed a time yet.
teaching.audioText: Tom will attend the planning meeting if he can, and Sara will too, but neither of them has confirmed a time yet.

teaching.en: I prefer the morning session and Mia the evening one, which saves us from repeating the whole sentence twice.
teaching.es: Yo prefiero la sesión de la mañana y Mia la de la tarde, lo que nos evita repetir toda la frase dos veces.
teaching.explanationEs: Se omite «prefers» en la segunda parte, y one sustituye a «session» para no repetirlo.
segments: I prefer the morning session and Mia the evening one,
which saves us from repeating the whole sentence twice.
teaching.audioText: I prefer the morning session and Mia the evening one, which saves us from repeating the whole sentence twice.

teaching.en: The guests invited to the launch, most of them clients, must reply today, otherwise the caterer cannot finalise the numbers.
teaching.es: Los invitados al lanzamiento, la mayoría clientes, deben responder hoy; de lo contrario, el catering no puede cerrar las cifras.
teaching.explanationEs: Invited a la derecha del nombre sustituye a «who were invited»: se quitan who were.
segments: The guests invited to the launch, most of them clients,
must reply today, otherwise the caterer cannot finalise the numbers.
teaching.audioText: The guests invited to the launch, most of them clients, must reply today, otherwise the caterer cannot finalise the numbers.

teaching.en: The players were disappointed by the decision to postpone until further notice, and the delay in rescheduling could make matters worse.
teaching.es: Los jugadores quedaron decepcionados por la decisión de aplazar hasta nuevo aviso, y el retraso en reprogramarlo podría empeorar las cosas.
teaching.explanationEs: Decision to + verbo y delay in + -ing convierten acciones en nombres: la frase queda más compacta.
segments: The players were disappointed by the decision to postpone until further
notice, and the delay in rescheduling could make matters worse.
teaching.audioText: The players were disappointed by the decision to postpone until further notice, and the delay in rescheduling could make matters worse.

teaching.en: Try to pare down a long update: it can usually boil down to one request, so streamline it and keep only the reason and the date.
teaching.es: Intenta recortar una actualización larga: suele reducirse a una sola petición, así que simplifícala y deja solo el motivo y la fecha.
teaching.explanationEs: Pare down y streamline son verbos de edición; boil down to + nombre indica a qué se reduce la idea.
segments: Try to pare down a long update: it can usually boil down to
one request, so streamline it and keep only the reason and the date.
teaching.audioText: Try to pare down a long update: it can usually boil down to one request, so streamline it and keep only the reason and the date.

teaching.en: They asked me to shorten the speech and leave out the jokes, but cutting words should never reduce clarity about who does what.
teaching.es: Me pidieron acortar el discurso y omitir los chistes, pero recortar palabras nunca debe reducir la claridad sobre quién hace qué.
teaching.explanationEs: Leave out es omitir lo que sobra; comprimir no debe crear ambigüedad sobre el sujeto.
segments: They asked me to shorten the speech and leave out the jokes,
but cutting words should never reduce clarity about who does what.
teaching.audioText: They asked me to shorten the speech and leave out the jokes, but cutting words should never reduce clarity about who does what.

prompt.es: Elige la versión condensada que conserva el contraste entre los dos grupos de delegados.

choices.text: The delegates invited to the launch had to reply by Friday; those not invited were told afterwards.
The delegates inviting to the launch had to reply by Friday; those not inviting were told afterwards.
The delegates invited to the launch had to reply by Friday; those invited were told afterwards.

feedback.es: Invited sustituye a «who were invited» y el contraste se mantiene con those not invited; las otras versiones cambian el sentido, lo hacen contradictorio o no son gramaticales.

hint.es: Quita who were y comprueba que siga habiendo dos grupos distintos.

origin.text: Report extract: The delegates who were invited to the launch had to reply by Friday. The delegates who were not invited were told about the event afterwards.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ana asistirá al lanzamiento del viernes y Leo también.»

feedback.es: Tras and se omite el resto y se repite solo el auxiliar de la primera parte: will attend se reduce a will.

hint.es: Repite solo el auxiliar de la primera parte de la frase.

origin.text: Ana will attend the launch on Friday, and Leo ___, too.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La decisión de aplazar el viaje sorprendió a todos.»

answer.text: The decision to postpone the trip surprised everyone

feedback.es: La nominalización decision to + verbo convierte la acción en el sujeto de la frase.

hint.es: Empieza por The decision to + verbo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué provocó la pérdida del cliente según el informe.

choices.text: The decision itself, which most managers opposed.
The late delivery that came after the smaller order.
The managers' preference for waiting a little longer.

feedback.es: Según el informe, fue el retraso en la entrega posterior al pedido reducido lo que costó el cliente; la decisión y la espera son el contexto.

origin.audio: The report says the decision to reduce the order was taken in May, and the delay in delivery that followed cost the company a client. Some managers argued against the decision at the time, but most of them preferred to wait and see.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase reducida con su significado completo.

pairs: The decision to reduce the order

pairs.es: lo que se decidió: reducir el pedido
el equipo al que se invitó a cenar

feedback.es: El participio -ed tiene valor pasivo y el -ing valor activo; decision to + verbo nombra lo que se decidió.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión condensa el borrador y conserva todo su significado?

choices.text: The volunteers working on Sunday and Monday will both get lunch, although Sunday's will be smaller.
The volunteers working on Sunday and Monday will get lunch.
The volunteers working on Sunday and Monday will both get lunch, although Monday's will be smaller.

feedback.es: Hay que conservar que ambos grupos comen y que el almuerzo del lunes es menor: invertir los días cambia el sentido y omitir el contraste pierde información.

origin.text: Draft: The volunteers who are working on Sunday, and the volunteers who are working on Monday, will both get lunch, although the lunch on Monday will be smaller than the lunch on Sunday.

prompt.es: Completa sin repetir el nombre: «la segunda era mejor para un equipo pequeño.»

feedback.es: One sustituye a proposal tras el adjetivo second y evita repetir el nombre en la misma frase.

origin.text: We received two proposals. I liked them both, but the second ___ was clearly better suited to a small team.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión comprime la primera frase sin perder la relación causa-efecto?

choices.text: The supplier's delay in delivering the equipment led us to postpone the launch.
The supplier's decision to postpone the equipment delayed the launch.
Our decision to delay the equipment led the supplier to postpone the launch.

feedback.es: La nominalización delay in delivering mantiene al proveedor como causa y el aplazamiento como consecuencia; las otras invierten agentes o causas.

origin.text: Extract from the project report: Because the supplier delayed the delivery of the equipment, we decided to postpone the launch, which disappointed the clients who had been invited to the opening. The managers who were responsible for the messages have since drafted a short statement, and the statement that was sent on Monday explains that the launch will now take place in June. Some board members, who were unhappy about the delay, have asked us to reduce the budget for the event, although nobody has confirmed a figure.

prompt.es: Según el informe, ¿qué da a entender sobre los miembros de la junta?

choices.text: They want the launch to be cancelled completely.
They hold the delay against the event and want less spent on it.
They have already agreed a new figure for the budget.

feedback.es: El informe dice que están descontentos con el retraso y piden reducir el presupuesto, pero nadie ha confirmado ninguna cifra ni se habla de cancelar.

origin.text: Extract from the project report: Because the supplier delayed the delivery of the equipment, we decided to postpone the launch, which disappointed the clients who had been invited to the opening. The managers who were responsible for the messages have since drafted a short statement, and the statement that was sent on Monday explains that the launch will now take place in June. Some board members, who were unhappy about the delay, have asked us to reduce the budget for the event, although nobody has confirmed a figure.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los invitados a la boda deben confirmar hoy.»

answer.text: The guests invited to the wedding must confirm today
accepted: The guests invited to the wedding must confirm today
Today the guests invited to the wedding must confirm

feedback.es: Invited a la derecha del nombre reduce «who were invited» y la frase sigue con el verbo principal.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué da a entender la directora sobre el retraso.

choices.text: That Tom and Mia should both take the early shift.
That the team will vote on the shifts next week.
That waiting for an agreement was costing the team time.

feedback.es: La directora reprocha el retraso en acordar el horario y decide asignar ella los turnos; Tom y Mia solo exponen sus preferencias.

origin.audio: Tom prefers the early shift and Mia the late one. The manager listened to both of them, then said that, honestly, the delay in agreeing a timetable had already cost the team a whole week, so she would simply assign the shifts herself.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Podrías recortarlo a tres frases sin perder las fechas?»

feedback.es: Pare down es la colocación para recortar un texto hasta lo esencial sin perder la información clave.

origin.text: The summary is far too long. Could you ___ it down to three sentences without losing the dates?

prompt.es: Este mensaje comprimido confunde por sus pronombres: ¿qué duda tendría el lector?

choices.text: Who promised the files: Mia, Ana or Sara?
When exactly did Mia phone Ana about it?
Why were the files not ready by Friday?

feedback.es: El pronombre she puede referirse a tres mujeres: al comprimir hay que cuidar que quede claro quién hace qué.

origin.text: Message: Mia phoned Ana after she had spoken to Sara, and she promised to send the files on Friday, although she hadn't got them yet.
